description: Creates a 30-minute sandbox session of a Cnamio test application, without an account or credentials. Returns application_id, auth_token, expires_at and user_id. A sandbox session answers from a simulated DNS provider: nothing real is read or written and any domain name connects at once; a first label conflict. simulates records already in the way, pending. a record that never propagates, and the provider token "invalid" is refused.
name: start_sandbox
title: Get a sandbox session
